# Implementation Plan: Ticket Management

**Branch**: `007-ticket-management` | **Date**: 2026-08-25 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/007-ticket-management/spec.md`

**Note**: This file is generated by `/speckit-plan`; the artifact definitions below drive the implementation.

## Summary

Add a condominium ticket-management module. Residents create tickets from their own
space choosing one of three categories — repair request in the building, noise
complaint, or suggestion of a topic for the next condominium assembly — and writing a
description. The syndic sees open tickets in an inbox, replies to them, and then
closes them; closed tickets become read-only for both parties. Residents track only
their own tickets and the syndic's replies. v1 boundaries from the spec: no
re-opening, no resident follow-up messages, no attachments, no e-mail/push
notifications, no priority field, and tickets are identified (no anonymity).

Technical direction for this feature: **standard library first** (no web frameworks,
no ORM), **CSS-first over JavaScript**, and the constitution-mandated GOTTH
presentation stack (Go + Templ + Tailwind + HTMX). One new vertical slice
(`internal/features/tickets/`), two new tables (`tickets`, `ticket_replies`) with
plain SQL via `database/sql` + `pgx`, status persisted only as `open`/`closed`, and
category stored as stable i18n-backed keys.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Go 1.27 (module `github.com/leoarkiteto/zelo`), using the Go
standard library as the primary toolset.

**Primary Dependencies**:
- `github.com/a-h/templ` — server-rendered templates (constitution-mandated)
- Tailwind CSS + HTMX — CSS-first styling and minimal progressive enhancement
  (constitution-mandated)
- `github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib` — PostgreSQL driver registered with stdlib
  `database/sql` (driver only; no ORM)

**Storage**: PostgreSQL (local `docker-compose.yml` container) accessed via
`database/sql` + `pgx` stdlib driver and plain SQL. New tables: `tickets` and
`ticket_replies`. Existing tables reused: `condominiums`, `units`, `users`,
`audit_events`.

**Testing**: stdlib only — `testing`, `net/http/httptest`, and integration tests
against the dockerized PostgreSQL. TDD is mandatory: ticket tests are written first.

**Target Platform**: Linux server (server-rendered web application).

**Project Type**: web application (server-side GOTTH stack; no client-side SPA).

**Performance Goals**: Inbox and ticket lists render in under 1 second for a typical
condominium (hundreds of tickets per year); ticket creation completes in under 2
minutes of user time (spec SC-001).

**Constraints**:
- Standard library first: no web framework, no ORM, no session/migration/CSRF frameworks.
- CSS-first over JavaScript: presentation and interaction state come from Tailwind CSS;
  HTMX is used only for server-driven partial updates required by the GOTTH stack.
- CSRF protection on all state-changing routes (existing synchronizer-token middleware).
- Migrations are plain forward-only SQL files applied by the existing minimal runner.
- Vertical slice isolation: the `tickets` slice spans `core/{domain,ports,services}` →
  `handlers` → `repositories` → `templates` only, and reaches other code only through
  `internal/shared/*`.
- No client-side SPA framework.
- UI text is available in both `en` and `pt-br` through the existing i18n catalog.

**Scale/Scope**: Single condominium per user session; hundreds of tickets per year;
three fixed categories; two roles (resident roles `owner`/`tenant` and `syndic`).

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Status | Notes |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| I. GOTTH Stack | PASS | Go server + Templ + Tailwind + HTMX; no SPA. Ticket pages are server-rendered HTML with HTMX only for progressive enhancement. |
| II. Modular Monolith with Hexagonal Architecture | PASS | Ticket use cases live in `internal/features/tickets/core/services` and depend only on ports (interfaces); persistence adapters in `repositories/`; HTTP in `handlers/`; domain types in `core/domain`. |
| III. Vertical Slice Feature Isolation | PASS | Tickets slice spans handler → service → store for this feature only; shared code restricted to `internal/shared/*`. |
| IV. Test-First Development (NON-NEGOTIABLE) | PASS | Tests written first with stdlib `testing`/`httptest`; integration tests cover create/list/detail/reply/close, access control, closed-ticket read-only behavior, and the `0010_create_tickets.sql` migration. |
| V. SOLID, Design Patterns & Generated Code | PASS | Generated `*_templ.go` and Tailwind output produced only by `scripts/`; no hand edits to generated artifacts. |
| VI. Standard Library First & CSS-First | PASS | `database/sql` + plain SQL; no ORM, no search engine, no notification SDK; CSS-first with HTMX limited to progressive enhancement. |
| Repository Layout & Conventions | PASS | Follows `internal/features/<feature>/` vertical slice layout documented in the constitution; migration `0010` committed forward-only. |

**Gate result**: PASS — no violations requiring justification.

**Post-design re-check (after Phase 1)**: Still PASS. The data model adds two
plain-SQL tables (`tickets`, `ticket_replies`), persists only `open`/`closed`, stores
categories as stable keys with i18n labels, and keeps every route server-rendered
behind the existing auth/CSRF middleware — all implementable with `database/sql` and
the existing GOTTH stack, leaving the core framework-free.

```text
internal/
├── features/

│       ├── core/
│       │   ├── domain/            # TicketCategory, TicketStatus, Ticket, TicketReply,
│       │   │                      #   validation & status-transition rules
│       │   ├── ports/             # TicketStore, UnitResolver, AuditRecorder ports
│       │   └── services/          # TicketService: create, listMine, inbox, detail,
│       │                          #   reply, close with authorization rules
│       ├── handlers/              # deps.go, routes.go, tickets.go
│       ├── repositories/          # tickets.go — database/sql adapter
│       └── templates/             # tickets.templ (+ generated *_templ.go), smoke_test.go
├── shared/
│   └── i18n/catalog.go            # add tickets.* keys (en + pt-br)
migrations/
└── 0010_create_tickets.sql        # tickets + ticket_replies + indexes + audit allow-list
```

**Structure Decision**: Single server-rendered web application; one new vertical slice
(`tickets`) added alongside the existing `auth`, `directory`, `finance`, `home`,
`management`, and `profile` slices. No new shared modules are needed beyond i18n keys;
authentication/RBAC, CSRF, sessions, and DB access come from `internal/shared/*`
unchanged.
